title: Shared activity
createHelp: One task for the event, with separate personal participation. No week is required.
name: Activity name
fieldHelp: Choose two different duration fields by identity. Their task values are event durations; personal effort is a separate report source.
rosterHelp: This roster is separate from ordinary task collaborators. Adding someone proposes planned time and does not confirm attendance.
fullDuration: Full planned duration per participant. Actual attendance can be full, partial or absent.
noAutomaticAttendance: Creating the event does not confirm anyone's actual time.
invalidConfiguration: Review the name, event date, organizer, call participants and two different duration fields.
retry: Retry the original shared activity command
enableHelp: Use one task for a call and record each participant's time independently.
savedSummary: Duration {{duration}} min · {{count}} current participants · Known team effort {{minutes}} min · {{unknown}} unconfirmed
snapshotHelp: Confirmed time keeps its saved event duration and roster version. Current settings differ; use an explicit correction with a reason to change recorded time.
editDurationHelp: Edit event duration in the ordinary fields above. Saving this configuration creates planned contributions only.
sourceChanged: The source changed after this draft opened. Discard and reopen to review the latest version.
confirmHelp: Choose the people to confirm. Review each person's minutes before confirming. Not confirmed stays unknown; Absent is explicitly zero.
selfOnly: You can confirm your own attendance. The organizer role does not grant permission to record other people's time.
invalidAttendance: Select at least one permitted participant and review partial minutes and any correction reason.
ordinaryUnresolved: Finish or recover the ordinary task save before recording shared activity changes.
